condition: On a 1-row DataFrame, df.loc[:, col] = numpy-backed Series/ndarray into a pyarrow-backed column unwraps the value to a 0-d array and raises TypeError "Invalid value" in pandas 3.x (2.x only warns and recasts the column to float64).
workaround: Assign a value with the matching Arrow dtype (e.g. .astype("double[pyarrow]")) or assign the whole column with df["A"] = ... instead of df.loc[:, "A"] = ....
